- Maximum password length of 14 characters
- Password split into two 7-character halves

- LM supports up to 14 characters, so 12-character passwords still generate LM hashes

- No such built-in Windows feature exists
- ❌ Not the answer

**(D) The password contains capital letters**
- LM hashes convert everything to uppercase anyway — capital letters don't prevent LM hash generation
- ❌ Not the answer
